tools.name: words_that_rhyme
tools.description: Finds words that rhyme with a specific English word. Useful for creative writing, poetry, and lyrics. Data provided by the Datamuse API. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: synonyms_for_word
tools.description: Returns a list of synonyms and closely related words for a given term. Helps with vocabulary variety and finding the right word. Data provided by the Datamuse API. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: words_meaning_like
tools.description: A reverse dictionary tool that finds words matching a description or concept. Ideal when you know the meaning but have forgotten the specific word. Data provided by the Datamuse API. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: words_sounding_like
tools.description: Finds words that sound similar to a given word, even if spelled incorrectly. Useful for spelling assistance and phonetic matching. Data provided by the Datamuse API. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: word_definition
tools.description: Look up the dictionary definition, part of speech, and usage examples for an English word. Covers multiple meanings and nuances. Data from the Free Dictionary API via Wiktionary (CC BY-SA). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: word_pronunciation
tools.description: Retrieve the phonetic IPA spelling and audio links for an English word. Helps with correct pronunciation and spoken language. Data from the Free Dictionary API via Wiktionary (CC BY-SA). (cost: 1 credit)
